'''Hanover, '''officially the''' Republic of Hanover''', was a sovereign nation located in Central Europe that would end up participating in the [[Third Mexican-American War]]. Created after the dissolution of Germany, Hanover bordered Denmark to the north, Netherlands to the west, Bradenburg to the east, Saxony to the southeast, and Rhineland to the south. The main ethnic group of Hanover were German's, with small populative pockets of Dutch and Danish. The main religion is Protestantism and Christianity, with a plurality of Islamic and generally non-religious citizens. The official language of Hanover is German.

'''Rhineland, ''' officially the ''' Republic of Rhineland''', was a sovereign nation located in Central Europe that would end up participating in the [[Third Mexican-American War]]. 

== History ==
Created after the dissolution of [[Germany]], Rhineland bordered [[Hanover]] to the north, [[Saxony]] and [[Bavaria]] to the east, [[Switzerland]] to the south, and France and the Netherlands to the west. The main ethnic group of Rhineland were German's, with small populated pockets of French and Swiss. The main religion is Protestantism and Christianity, with a plurality of Islamic and generally non-religious citizens. The official language of Rhineland is German.

What if Mexico won the Third Mexican-American War (World War IV)?<ac_metadata title="Alternate History"> </ac_metadata>

I've written about this on deviantart before I'm not repeating the whole thing again. The basics of it are that Mexico would consolidate power in China, Pakistan, and Southern Europe, the US would continue to exist, but the colonies would become independent, with Mars becoming a Superpower in its own right in an interplanetary Cold War with Mexico after Mars takes back Luna and establishes territorial dominion over Australia and Papua New Guinea to control the Pacific space elevator. Venus and the Moon would be the two points of contention in the Interplanetary Cold War, and Mexico would develop their own warp ships only a few years after the War turning it into an interstellar cold war.

There could be a alternate history page (in universe it is literature) on here to address these kinds of stuff some time

Finally found it: Well, let's assume that happens in a scenario where Halvidar never becomes President, and the MSIF becomes a legitimate political party on Mars making it next to impossible for the colonials to join the war.  Mexico would retake the Southwest in short order, and probably push their military into Louisiana and the great plains just to make a point. The war would last much longer in this timeline without the devastating tactics of the Colonies, probably into the mid 2140s, and it would end with the US Suing for peace and ceding most of Aztlan's territory to Mexico. Mexico would consolidate their gains around the world where the US could not hope for a serious victory. A new Chinese Confederacy of sorts would form out of Mexican client states in China and India would be partitioned far more drastically. The Poles would control Northern Europe, bringing the American nightmare to fruition, however the decline in European populations and scarcity of resources would make this far less of a threat than such a scenario would be today. Mexico would establish an alliance of Southern European states in a kind of Neo MU to counter the Poles, sewing up North Africa in the alliance as well. The Beanstalk elevator would remain in American hands, but the Uganada Tower would become an international facility controlled by the locals, while Mexico would informally control the Ecuador tower. Mexico would become the world's most powerful nation-state on Earth by war's end, and over the next century the US would begin to fragment. First, the colonies would break off, almost immediately after Mexico declares victory. Mars would be the most powerful and most unified by far, while the Jovians and Titans would be somewhere between independent and somewhere between US and Martian colonies. The US would maintain control over much of the Moon, but Mexico would have taken a sizable portion of the territory, as well as several asteroid bases. On Earth, the US would remain united, but separatism would rise with Mexican control over Texas and there's likely be a Forth-Mexican American War over the Port of Louisiana, involving Cascadian, possibly even Neo-Confederate/Southron separatists. But the Truth is with control over Texas and the Carribean Mexico would be the real power in North America from that point forward. The real struggle on the international stage would between the Poles and the Martians. As the United States recedes, Mars would rise to fill the void in Space. Venus would be a Martian Colony, and the Interplanetary Trade Commission would become a kind of interplanetary NATO with Mars and Titan being the two most important members. Eventually the American Lunar colonies would look more toward Mars for their security than on Earth, and while Mexico would be the most powerful country on Earth, Mars would be the most powerful country period, and would begin playing a greater role in Earth politics after Mexico seizes control of the elevators. Beanstalk would eventually be transferred to Mars, probably in a sale by the US. Australia (independent by this point) and Oceania would be ground zero for Martian influence on Earth, along with what remained of US backed China and East Africa. The influence would be very informal for the first 50 years of Pax-Mexicana, but eventually the two powers would come to blows over either former American colonies around Earth or the Moon. Poland would be a Martian ally in that war, and Mars would win.  The First Interplanetary War, would be relatively small, but it would end with Martian control over most American territory around the Earth and on the Moon, and Mars annexing Australia and most of the former American territories in Oceania (which would have been independent for some time or owned by Mexico). Mars would also either annex East Africa outright or simply declare them to be a protectorate. An Interplanetary Cold War would define the next half century, with Mexico and Mars grappling for control of equatorial territory and allies. But Mars would have the advantage of a massive population and most of the resources of the Solar System.
